name: CLASSROOM
expectations: I listen and follow directions.
I keep trying and cheer others on.
I participate and set a good example.
I help classmates and care for our room.
I put my supplies where they belong.
I use a safe body and solve problems with words.

name: HALLWAY & TRANSITIONS
expectations: I face forward and follow my line.
I am patient and use a quiet voice.
I show others how to walk safely.
I respect classes that are learning.
I stay in order and close line gaps.
I keep my hands, feet, and objects to myself.

name: BATHROOM
expectations: I use the bathroom and return to class.
I respect everyone’s privacy.
I tell an adult when something is wrong.
I help keep our bathroom clean.
I flush, wash my hands, and use the trash can.
I give others space and use the bathroom safely.

name: PLAYGROUND, FIELD & BLACKTOP
expectations: I freeze at the whistle and walk to line.
I include others and play fairly.
I help others and tell an adult about unsafe play.
I take turns and care for our play areas.
I take care of balls, equipment, and my things.
I play safely and follow game rules.

name: CAFETERIA & LUNCH COURT
expectations: I focus on eating and follow directions.
I use polite words and respect others’ food.
I show good table manners.
I help keep our lunch area clean.
I follow lunch routines and clean my spot.
I sit safely and keep my food to myself.

name: AUDITORIUM
expectations: I listen to the speaker or performance.
I clap and cheer at the right times.
I show others how to be a great audience.
I help everyone feel welcome and respected.
I stay with my group and take my things.
I walk safely and give others space.

name: LIBRARY
expectations: I listen and join library activities.
I use a quiet voice and enjoy reading.
I show others how to care for books.
I help make the library welcoming for everyone.
I put books and supplies where they belong.
I move calmly and handle books gently.

name: VAPA
expectations: I listen and work on my creative activity.
I try new things and appreciate others’ art.
I participate and encourage others.
I celebrate others’ work and care for our space.
I use supplies carefully and put them away.
I use tools safely and give others space.

name: PE
expectations: I listen for signals and follow directions.
I keep trying and show good sportsmanship.
I play fairly and cheer on my teammates.
I include everyone and care for our play space.
I use equipment correctly and put it away.
I play safely and respect others’ bodies.

name: STEAM
expectations: I follow directions and work on the challenge.
I learn from mistakes and try again.
I share ideas and help my team.
I work with others and care for shared tools.
I keep my workspace neat and put tools away.
I use tools safely and solve problems with words.

name: ANIMATION
expectations: I follow directions and work on my project.
I am patient and respect others’ ideas.
I use technology responsibly and help others.
I respect others’ work and care for our devices.
I keep my equipment and project organized.
I handle devices gently and use kind words.
